scope: Fix confirmed correctness/resource issues from server-runtime-repair-soak-20261009. Test server LINEAR_PERPETUAL only; core matching/account state unchanged.

catchupRerun.limits: Initial new batch test verified a reused cleared list after the call; corrected the test to copy frames during the call and reran all 14 batch cases. Other integration classes passed unchanged.

cacheBatchCommitValidation.limits: Real Spring listener container and business cache with Kafka MockConsumer transport; measures offset commit calls, not network throughput.

candle-reconciliation.json.limits: Read-only recent closed-minute reconciliation; does not validate private account balances or old historical encodings. Captured last stable offset is fixed; consumer does not join or commit a group.

three-candle-repair-plan.json.boundary: Only the three audited CLOSED minute rows, original values matched transactionally; no account, orders, Core, Kafka consumer offset or trade data writes. Existing current sequence has passed this immutable committed source.

proxyEvidence.scope: EOF on the proxied path; exact failing hop not established. The attempted no-proxy launch still used SOCKS and is excluded as a direct control.
